de1.P4.C1.ly_do: a) $a^2-b^2-7a-7b = (a+b)(a-b-7)$ (phuong an 1) dung. b) $x^2-4xy+4y^2+x-2y = (x-2y)(x-2y+1)$ (phuong an 0) dung.

de1.P4.C3.ly_do: Y a dung: $\frac{2x-3y-3}{(x-y)(x+y)}$ (phuong an 1). Y b: loi giai cu viet $9-x^2 = (x-3)(x+3)$ thieu dau tru (dung la $9-x^2 = -(x-3)(x+3)$) nen tinh ra 2, mau thuan voi shortCorrect -2. Da sua loi giai: ket qua dung la -2, khop shortCorrect. Dap an khong doi.

de1.P6.C1.ly_do: Dap an A dung (kiem bang so: x=1, y=1 cho 18/60 = 0,3 = 3/(8+2)). Loi giai cu sai: viet mau $64y^2-4x^2 = (8y-2x)^2$ (sai, khai trien co them -32xy) va ket luan $\frac{3x}{8y-2x}$ (phuong an D) mau thuan voi dap an A da luu. Da sua loi giai theo phan tich dung: $\frac{3x}{8y+2x}$. Dap an khong doi. Co muc_do thuoc phan loai, khong doi qua sua.

de1.P6.C2.ly_do: Nang suat nam ngoai $\frac{y}{x}$, nam nay $\frac{y+4}{x-6}$; ti so $= \frac{x(y+4)}{y(x-6)}$ (phuong an C) dung. Co muc_do thuoc phan loai, khong doi qua sua.
